### To propose

Not first come, first served. Comment with what you'll build, when you expect to have it working, where the code will live, the license, how you'll keep it working after the award is paid, and whether your organization benefits from this work, and how. Include your GitHub username and this confirmation pasted as written. See the [paid contributor terms](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-protocol/blob/main/PAID_CONTRIBUTOR_TERMS.md).

```md
- [x] I confirm that I am a United States person aged eighteen or over, that I meet the eligibility requirements in section 1 of the paid contributor terms, that I have read and I agree to the paid contributor terms, and that any work I submit is mine to contribute.
```

Proposals close [date]. We pick one and say why on the issue. A single proposal still gets reviewed and can be declined.

If your proposal is chosen, email commongrants-contributors@agile6.com with your GitHub username and a link to the issue, so we can reach you privately about payment.
